Well Officer, I chose the United States because it is a global leader in research and graduate education. While other countries have strong programs in my field, the US leads the world in applying advanced geospatial data to urban climate adaptation. My research on Surface Urban Heat Islands relies heavily on multi-sensor satellite imagery, and the US academic system provides unmatched computational scale for the machine learning models I use. Mastering these advanced methodologies in the US will give me the technical authority I need to return and tackle Dhaka's severe urban heat challenges as a senior researcher.
